167: Yoh was born into the famous Shaman family, Asakura. He has a twin brother named Hao who is a powerful reincarnation of the original HAO who keeps getting reborn.
169: Samurai that died during the Muromachi period 600 years ago - now is Yoh's ghost companion. He is very powerful and wise but quite taciturn and extremely devoted to "Lord Yoh" ("Yō-dono" in Japanese).
170: Aggressive and decisive, Anna is a pragmatic person who appears cold and harsh. However, she has shown that she genuinely cares for those important to her. She is extremely dedicated to being "The Ultimate Shaman Queen" and the wife to Yoh, the first friend that she ever had.
171: Len is a Shaman from China, one of the few remaining members of the Tao Family, who after their years of serving as the guardians of the Forbidden City, became outcasts and condemned as witches and devils.

173: Horohoro is an Ainu from Hokkaidō, a prefecture in Japan. In the English anime, he is described as from "the Northern Woods" instead of from Hokkaidō. He is the older brother of Pirica and his guardian ghost is Kororo, a small nature spirit.
174: An intelligent but worrisome teen who always carries a "dictionary/encyclopedia/compendium of all human knowledge", and has a sixth sense, meaning he can see supernatural beings, even though he is not a Shaman. He is very expressive and a bit panicky.
1529: A British Shaman and a traditional "dowser", whose parents were killed by Hao. Lyserg has dramatic interactions with all of the main characters at some point, and though he travels with them for a long time, he fights against Yoh's team more than once during the series.
3262: Faust is a descendant of the original Faustus, a man who made a pact with the devil. In Shaman King, Faust the eighth was a lonely boy who had only one friend, named Eliza.
4327: Jun is the older sister of Tao Ren. She is a dao-si who can reanimate corpses. Her jiāngshī (guardian zombie, in Japanese, "kyonshii") is Lee Bailong (known as Lee Pai-Long in the anime), a famous kung-fu movie star similar to Bruce Lee who died seventeen years ago.
6195: Tamao is a shy girl who has a huge crush on Yoh Asakura, even though she knows that Yoh is engaged to Anna Kyōyama. Initially, she is so shy that she uses her sketchbook and points to pictures in order to tell people what she wants to say.

7147: Hao's most loyal ally. She was a malnourished baby in South Africa when Hao found her.
9147: A spirit passed down for generations in Lyserg Diethel's familiy. She is Lyserg's main spirit in the manga, but he abandons her for a stronger spirit, Zeruel
9148: Tokagero is a 600 year old spirit from the same time as Amidamaru. He was a thief who was eventually killed by Amidamaru and because he wanted revenge he was not able to pass on. Because of his hatred he eventually turned his skin lizard green.
12677: Ryunosuke Umemiya, usually called "Wooden Sword" Ryu, is a character in the anime and manga Shaman King. In the English anime, his name is Rio. A direct translation of his nickname reads "Dragon of the Wooden Sword". He is a Capricorn.
15349: Joco met his mentor, Orona, on a snowy night when he was young. Orona was among the crowd of people who circled around a victim who was being robbed. The police had the robber surrounded, but he threatened everyone by threatening to kill the victim.
15558: Horohoro's little sister, who trains him in a similar manner to Anna's training of Yoh. Though not shown in the manga or anime, the author has stated that Pirica's partner spirit is Torara, a Marimo or Torasanpe as said in the Ainu language.
16145: Marion (Mari) is the blonde-haired member of the group. She is from Italy, dresses in the Lolita fashion, and always talks in the third person (she does not follow this practice in the English translation of the anime).
18342: Eliza is Faust's first, only, and one true love. She was ill with a fatal disease since her childhood. As the only woman to care for Faust VIII, he, in return, slaved over his studies to find a cure for her. After her recovery, they married and opened a clinic together.
